{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "R377",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the health bar is not visible properly on iPhone 17.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I can’t see the health bar properly on the iPhone 17 with even having the tool screen shortened. I never had that issue on android."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R391",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports they can only see half their energy bar despite changing settings.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Love the game\nFor some reason I can only see half my energy bar I’ve changed all the settings no luck."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R376",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game deletes all progress after a device crash, causing loss of a year of gameplay.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Could be 5 stars if they could figure out how to add a save option\nWill make you waste countless hours on it and then break your heart by deleting everything you do. There is no way save it other than going to sleep which doesn’t actually save it at all. My brand new iPad died ONCE and I lost more than a year of game play because there is no save option. I’m not playing 1970’s pong for a reason."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R375",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the iPhone version is unplayable due to a UI overlay covering the backpack selection box.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Great game with a catch\nI have been loving this game it’s relaxing and has it’s addictive points. The catch is that it’s unplayable on the iPhone. The camera oval covers the entire backpack selection box making your inventory virtually inaccessible. In any other game I’d give this a 1-star review but the game is just so much fun and at so low a cost I just can’t justify lowering the score. Really it’s an apple problem."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R378",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports spending over 100 hours but losing a year of progress due to lack of save functionality.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Best game and purchase I have ever made\nI love this game I am addicted. I have over a hundred hours yet have barely scratched the surface of this amazing game. There are so many different playstyles, you can kill monsters, farm, fish, befriend, craft, cook, decorate and so much more. I love krobus as he gives me an opportunity to fulfill the achievement and stardrop for friendship/ having a housemate without having to get married, he’s just so adorable in his own way. There are many things to do post main game, which I would say is completing the community center (or if you have no soul, going the Kona route) it also has a wonderful community with co op local if you just look up a little Easter egg, there is so much to discover for casual players and completionists alike, this is my favorite game ever and is very well priced."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R379",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the mobile version lacks multiplayer, which they wish to have.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I love the game\nI love the game in general I just wish it had multiplayer on mobile,so far great game and have been playing it for a long time,"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R383",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game lacks multiplayer beyond local LAN, which they wish to have.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Añadan el multijugador\nEl juego e’ muy bueno, solo le falta el multijugador que no sea por red local o lan."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R382",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is a must-have but wishes for multiplayer mode on iOS.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This is a must!\nPlease add multiplayer mode in IOS!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R388",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game sometimes blacks out the screen except for the top toolbar, making it hard to play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "LOVE THIS GAME but…\nI really love this game. But there’s one thing I hope the developers can fix. Sometimes when I play almost my entire screen goes black except for the top of my tool bar and how much gold and the time. So could you guys please fix this as soon as you can? Ok thank you bye!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R384",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the UI does not fit the screen on iPhone 16 Pro Max, with Dynamic Island causing clipping.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Not optimized for iPhone 15 Pro Max on iOS 21.\nIt doesn’t fit the screen. Things are too clumped together on the side bar due to Dynamic Island.\nEdit to add: Don’t let these new high star reviews fool you. Things are cut off and zoomed in. It’s rip off of 4.99 tbh."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R385",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is only available on Steam for MacOS but not on App Store, limiting access.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Waitting for MacOS Version\nI bought this game 3 years ago. But I still waiting for version can play on Mac. I show it can download from Steam for MacOS but i can’t download on AppStore."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R386",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent requests Arabic language support to improve accessibility for Arabic-speaking users.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Add Arabic language\nI really want to understand the game better and ask you to add the Arabic language to make the experience better for the Arab society because we love the game very much"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R387",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports fishing mechanics are difficult, causing frustration.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Definitely worth the price\nStardew valley is one of my favorite games if you want casual you can just farm but if you want action you can fight monsters! My only problem if fishing, the fishing bar I quite difficult to win but thats just me."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R389",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game lacks cross-platform play, preventing play with a sibling on PS5.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Amazing game\nThis game is incredible, and very relaxing to play and I’d love for it to have a universal crossplay feature so I can play with my sister who plays the game on a PS5"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R390",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game lacks cross-platform play, preventing play with a fiancé on Xbox.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Favorite game! But I wish cross play was available\nThis game is awesome. it’s been a great game for me and my long distance fiancé to play at night while on face time. We work together with the farm but the competitiveness comes in for us at the caverns and caves it’s us against the clock and each other trying to find the latter first. 😅\nWe hacked through for the co-op to play long distance in mobile but I do hope in the future it comes available to cross play from X-box to mobile as my fiancé will play till the crack of dawn as I fall asleep drooling on my phone 😂 he wants to co-op our world on Xbox while I’m on mobile so he can play better as his phone is getting old and crashing every 30 minutes."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R392",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game exceeded expectations and is now their favorite, played on both PS5 and iOS.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Exceed my expectations\nI’ve been a try hard gamer playing very competitive online games and give a shot on this initially on ps5, felt in love and bought for iOS too"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R393",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has a glitch where villagers at the Desert Festival do not appear.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Amazing game but glitches\n1) Villager vendors at Desert Festival don’t usually appear"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R393",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports a glitch blocking access to the mayor's room shorts.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Amazing game but glitches\n2) You can’t get to the shorts under the mayor’s room :( The end of the maze is blocked off somehow."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R395",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports fishing mechanics are described as a 'hoax' and 'absolutely horrible'.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Fun to play minus fishing\nSuper fun game and relatively easy to grasp, my reasoning for the 4 stars is because the fishing mechanics are absolutely horrible. Real life tuna fishing is easier and more based fishing. The fishing seems like a hoax to me in the game. Expect to be nothing more than annoyed with it"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R396",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the fishing bar is difficult to win, causing frustration.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Definitely worth the price\nStardew valley is one of my favorite games if you want casual you can just farm but if you want action you can fight monsters! My only problem if fishing, the fishing bar I quite difficult to win but thats just me."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R397",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the fishing mechanic is the only quest type they dislike, requesting more non-fishing quests.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Love it but we need more quest to do\nI Abouslty love it but one thing. I need more quest cause I don’t like fishing and that’s the only thing it gives me so I just want more quest that doesn’t have to be on the wanted thingy"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R398",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has a glitch where the weapon automatically switches to a scythe during combat.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Why a Scythe?\nMy weapon automatically switching to the scythe over and over again while I’m in the middle of fighting is pissing me off on another level right now"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R399",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game crashes when ending co-op from iPad to computer.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Trouble shoot\nCrashes on coop from computer to I pad when we try to end our night."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R400",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game crashes multiple times, making it unplayable.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Keeps crashing\nI love this game. I’ve been playing it on and off for about 3 years now. I don’t have a console anymore since it crapped out on me so I bought the game on mobile. It was going well for awhile until it crashed and it did so multiple times basically making the game unplayable for me cause I don’t want to keep redoing my days. Please fix"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R401",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has a UI bug where the energy meter is cut off on iPhone.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Not suited for iPhone\nI can’t really wrap my head around why the dev can’t scale the UI to fit the screen. Not being able to see to bottom 1/3 of your Energy bar makes many parts of the game unplayable. The touch controls are a bit wonky as well. I’m very disappointed."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R402",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has a UI bug where the energy meter is cut out on the app version.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Amazing game. Bad UI on App\nThis is an amazing game. :) However, the UI cuts out energy meter. It kind of makes it very hard to play."
    },

      "ref": "R403",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has a UI bug where the energy meter is cut out on the app version.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Screen safe area\nPlease give option to adjust screen safe area size. This used to be option but I can’t find it in the settings."

      "stance": "risk",
